codeSystems.name: NMDPCMVStatusCS
codeSystems.title: NMDP CMV Status Code System
codeSystems.description: Text-based status codes for CMV IgG antibody presence in donor and CBU testing.

codeSystems.name: NMDPDonorStatusCS
codeSystems.title: NMDP Donor Status
codeSystems.description:
Status codes for NMDP registered donors. These codes represent the
enterprise Registry Status maintained by NMDP, indicating a donor's availability
for patient search, matching, and product request activities. Source: ODS
DonorWithSampleResponse (v05). In FHIR Donor API payloads, donor status is
conveyed as a valueString on the donor-status extension.

codeSystems.name: NMDPOrderTypeCS

codeSystems.name: NMDPCenterTypeCS

codeSystems.name: NMDPSpecimenTypeCS
